description: Clinical test definitions (MII KDS Labor / INTERPOLAR). Each entry = one distinct clinical test (Laborparameter: component + tier) -> one FHIR ValueSet + one Observation profile. 'standard' = the routine value a clinician means; 'specialized' = a clinically distinct variant (free PSA, LDH isoenzymes, WBC differential, cord blood). The ECL selects the SNOMED-LOINC observables; the ValueSet is emitted LOINC-coded; the Observation profile (FSH, derived from MII KDS Laborbefund) binds the ValueSet to Observation.code. 'extra_loinc' lists LOINC codes a rule cannot reach because the LOINC Ontology release does not model them (ontology gaps); they are added to the enumeration by hand and documented on the review page.

_ecl_blocks._doc: Documentation of the building blocks the rules share (the rules below are written out in full; scripts read 'ecl' only).
_ecl_blocks.BLOOD: (<< 119297000 |Blood specimen (specimen)| MINUS (<< 122556008 |Cord blood specimen (specimen)| OR << 737357006 |Fetal blood specimen (specimen)| OR << 440500007 |Dried blood spot specimen (specimen)|))
_ecl_blocks.BLOOD_doc: Block A, the specimen of every blood test: Blood specimen and its subtypes (venous, arterial, capillary, mixed venous, serum, plasma) MINUS cord blood, fetal blood and dried blood spot. Observables 'in Fetus' carry no Direct site in the LOINC Ontology and are invisible to any site-constrained rule.
_ecl_blocks.CONC: (<< 118539007 |Mass concentration (property) (qualifier value)| OR << 118556004 |Substance concentration (property) (qualifier value)| OR << 118569000 |Arbitrary concentration (property) (qualifier value)|)
_ecl_blocks.CONC_doc: Block B, the interchangeable concentration properties of a routine quantitative test: mass, substance and arbitrary concentration. Ratios, fractions and rates are not concentrations and stay out.

extra_loinc.display: MCHC [Entitic Moles/volume] in Red Blood Cells
extra_loinc.reason_en: LOINC 59467-1 (MCHC as entitic substance concentration, mmol/L; active since LOINC 2.32) has no observable in the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21, although every other active MCH/MCHC/MCV term has one. It is added by hand so that SI-unit reporting is covered; a change request has been filed with the LOINC Ontology maintainers.
extra_loinc.reason_de: LOINC 59467-1 (MCHC als Entitic substance concentration, mmol/L; aktiv seit LOINC 2.32) hat in der LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21 kein Observable, obwohl jeder andere aktive MCH/MCHC/MCV-Term eines hat. Er ist von Hand ergänzt, damit die Berichterstattung in SI-Einheiten abgedeckt ist; ein Change Request an die LOINC-Ontology-Pflege ist gestellt.
